rules.name: nonce_marked
rules.expr: ok and called("claim") and post("nonceUsed", sender, arg(1)) == 0

rules.name: nonce_sticky
rules.expr: ok and called("claim") and pre("nonceUsed", sender, arg(1)) != 0 and post("nonceUsed", sender, arg(1)) == 0

rules.name: claim_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("claim") and (post("totalClaimed", sender) != pre("totalClaimed", sender) + arg(0) or post("TokenC05.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC05.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC05.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC05.balanceOf", sender) + arg(0))
rules.why: claim pays exactly amount to caller and books it

rules.name: claimed_only_caller
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("totalClaimed", u) != pre("totalClaimed", u)

rules.name: claimed_only_claim
rules.expr: ok and not called("claim") and post("totalClaimed", u) != pre("totalClaimed", u)

rules.name: token_out_auth
rules.expr: ok and post("TokenC05.balanceOf", A0) < pre("TokenC05.balanceOf", A0) and not called("claim") and sender != pre("owner")
rules.why: only claim or owner moves pool tokens

rules.name: token_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("claim") or called("sweep") or called("setSigner") or called("setPaused")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC05.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC05.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no one loses tokens in others' calls

rules.name: claim_only_to_caller
rules.expr: ok and called("claim") and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC05.balanceOf", u) != pre("TokenC05.balanceOf", u)

rules.name: sweep_owner
rules.why: owner only and only while paused
